page.text:
A concrete real is an equivalence class of Cauchy sequences of rational
numbers. Two sequences are equivalent when their difference converges to
zero. Constants and arithmetic are induced term by term; reciprocal is
applied to a representative of a nonzero class, with the zero class
handled separately.
